title: Matthew Stafford understands Rams drafting Ty Simpson: "I'm not 25 years old"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matthew Stafford understands Rams drafting Ty Simpson: "I'm not 25 years old"
sources.description: Matthew Stafford is 38 years old, and he knows there's a reason the Rams drafted the 23-year-old quarterback Ty Simpson in the first round.
